title: Page 24
transc:
9.45 AM 
Washn Aug 22nd 1862
For Axis Wherrying took place yesterday 
on the Line of the Ginger
with considerable loss on both sides
cannonading this morning with probability of
a vermin Wales Brutus Corps is
moving up the Spartan to Yankee
Reno at Kellys ford Bolivias corps
is ordered to Alexandria & will
be sent by Soap to the
Gland as rapidly as possible Forage
ordered to Hastings & Schooners to
you I have heard no complaint
about Ramsay signed Abortion made easy


10 15 A. M 22nd 62 
For Asp The great object now
is to hold the line of
the gland till we can get
together sufficient forces to take the
offensive I forced to Winthrop we
must Wyoming in wean & dispute
every inch of ground till we
reach Magnet & the Occoquan The
new levies will be put into first into
the Rewards as a reserve. Of
